== Printed shorthand symbols ==
The transcription now uses the printed shorthand from the complete [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf December 2025 publisher sheet], p. 3, and the corresponding card image. The numeric pilot symbol adds 2 to the power of anything this character pilots. The [https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], pp. 99 and 101, defines this notation. The Released bound follows this own publisher edition; repository timestamps are retained as revision history. Card names, IDs and images are retained.
